title: decode_uuencode panics/wraps on bytes < 0x20 in data line
description: mime-tree/src/decode.rs decode_uuencode(): the expression (encoded[i] - 32) at lines 237-240 uses bare subtraction on u8. Any byte value < 0x20 (e.g. 0x00) in an encoded data line causes integer underflow: panic in debug builds (overflow checks), wrapping to a wrong 6-bit value in release builds. Trigger: a UU body where any encoded data byte is < 0x20 (e.g. malformed or adversarial input). The uuencoding crate correctly uses wrapping_sub; this path does not.
acceptance_criteria: Use wrapping_sub(32) & 0x3F on each encoded byte in decode_uuencode, matching the uuencoding crate. Add a test with a 0x00 byte in the encoded payload to guard regression.
close_reason: Fixed wrapping_sub(32) & 0x3F in mime-tree/src/decode.rs; added no-panic test with 0x00 byte
